He pried the cork loose with his pocket knife, pulling out a crumpled note written in loopy blue ink: it was from a seven-year-old girl who’d tossed the bottle into the Atlantic off the coast of Maine three years prior, writing that she hoped the note would reach someone who needed a little bit of joy that day. He smiled, tucking the note into his journal before lighting the lamp, already drafting a reply to tuck back into the bottle for the next tide to carry.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在淡蓝色的夜露里，街灯拖着暖黄的光晕斜斜铺在空荡的柏油路上，只有早班的环卫车缓缓驶过，车轮碾过落叶发出细碎的声响。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗亮着暖光，便利店的玻璃门透着冷白的灯，值夜班的店员正趴在柜台上打盹。风带着江面上的湿意吹过，偶尔有晚归的骑手骑着电动车掠过，影子在墙根下拉得很长，整座城市正等着第一缕晨光把它唤醒。", "w03": "- Imagine you’re standing in front of a long line to buy ice cream, and you want to know how many people are ahead of you.\n- You ask the person directly in front of you how many people are ahead of them, and they pass that question forward to the next person in line.\n- When the person at the very front answers “zero people ahead”, everyone in line passes that number back up, adding one each time until you get your final count."}
